value.rationale: All sample sizes and all feasible fixed-point classes have a sharp conditional expectation law, with a unique parity-switching optimal class (one fixed point for odd n, two for even n). It distinguishes first-order orthogonality Cov(F,C)=0 from strictly negative higher factorial covariances and quantifies a natural exact conditioning phenomenon. No arbitrary parameter slice or numerical-only result.
